name: Cultist: Everpresent boosts Presence proc chance through the native spellmod path (#1541)
contract: 300272 is an ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) aura, MiscValue=18 (SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS), EffectBasePoints=9/DieSides=1 (+1 per SpellInfo.cpp:489) giving a flat +10; EffectSpellClassMask (512,0,64) hits every real 'Presence of <Old God>' spell in family 31, confirmed in Spell.dbc, including 803341 'Presence of N'zoth' (SpellFamilyFlags (16384,0,64), base ProcChance=5). 300272 is not in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-31 routing table (SpellInfo.cpp:1497-1508), so the generic fallback IsAffected(familyName, mask) applies the mod with no script. The spell_modifier metric exercises Player::ApplySpellMod on this exact spell, the same call the real proc-chance roll uses.

steps.label: SETUP: Presence of N'zoth keeps its base 5 proc chance before Everpresent
SETUP: an unrelated family-31 spell outside the mask is unaffected
Everpresent adds 10 points to Presence of N'zoth's proc chance
Everpresent leaves an unrelated spell's chance-of-success unmodified
